tools.name: validate_bpmn
tools.description: Checks a BPMN 2.0 XML file against the LucidFlow validator rules and returns the errors and warnings with their locations. Free, no account, nothing is stored. Limits: 200 KB, 1500 elements, 50 levels deep, no DOCTYPE, 2 seconds. Rate: 60 calls per minute and 1000 per day per IP address; a BPMN XML

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "validate_bpmn" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
